# Codex app-server fixture

The fixture follows the official headerless JSON-RPC 2.0 JSONL contract
generated by `codex app-server generate-json-schema` from `codex-cli 0.149.1`.
It covers initialize/initialized, `account/read`, `model/list`, thread start and
resume, turn start/interrupt, native approval requests, item and plan events,
usage, unknown notifications, completion, tool failure, rejected approval, and
malformed stream isolation.

The fixture never calls a model or reads real Codex credentials.
